summary: The Vice President, Human Resources and Transformation, Toronto Parking Authority, will provide a verbal confidential update to the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority on collective bargaining and confidential human resources matters.
decided: The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority received the item for information.
